rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a business or firm, including a partnership when its legal structure is not the focus.

example.english: This firm has been in business for many years.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you mean securing something in place.

example.english: The table leg is a bit wobbly, so we’ll firm it in place first.
example.traditional: 張枱腳郁郁哋，我哋先固定佢。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi4 gok3 juk1 juk1 dei2 ngo5 dei6 sin1 gu3 ding6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when making a thing, system, effect, or situation stronger rather than simply holding it in place.

example.english: We need to firm up security so people can’t break in.
example.traditional: 我哋要加強保安，唔畀人亂闖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 bou2 on1 m4 bei2 jan4 lyun6 cong2

rows.note: Use this colloquially for making a loose, soft, or insufficiently solid physical object firm.

example.english: This clay is too soft; we need to firm it up first.
example.traditional: 呢嚿泥太腍，要整實啲先。
example.jyutping: nei1 gau6 nai4 taai3 nam4 jiu3 zing2 sat6 di1 sin1

rows.note: Use this mainly for reinforcing a structure or installation so that it becomes more secure and resistant.

example.english: The construction team is coming tomorrow to firm up the bridge.
example.traditional: 工程隊聽日嚟加固條橋。
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 deoi6 ting1 jat6 lai4 gaa1 gu3 tiu4 kiu4

rows.note: Use 穩陣 as the all-purpose choice for something secure, sound, or dependable, rather than for material hardness or personal resolve.

example.english: This bank is firm and reliable, so I feel safe keeping my money there.
example.traditional: 呢間銀行做嘢好穩陣，啲錢放喺度我好放心。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ngan4 hong4 zou6 je5 hou2 wan2 zan6 di1 cin2 fong3 hai2 dou6 ngo5 hou2 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use 實淨 for a physical thing, body part, or piece of land that is solid and firm rather than soft or unstable.

example.english: This table is firm enough that it won't move.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 gau3 sat6 zing6 m4 wui5 juk1

rows.note: Use 堅定 for a settled conviction or unwavering commitment, rather than an insistence directed at someone.

example.english: They have stayed firm in their choice.
example.traditional: 佢對自己嘅選擇一直都好堅定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 syun2 zaak6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gin1 ding6

rows.note: Use 堅決 for an adamant refusal, decision, or insistence when the speaker will not accept dissent.

example.english: I remain firm and will not accept this arrangement.
example.traditional: 我堅決唔接受呢個安排。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 kyut3 m4 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this when the important point is that the business is jointly run by partners rather than simply being a company.

example.english: They formed a firm together and opened a restaurant.
example.traditional: 佢哋兩個合夥開咗間餐廳。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hap6 fo2 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the business name or trading name under which the firm operates.

example.english: Please enter the trading name of the firm on the form.
example.traditional: 請喺表格填上商號名稱。
example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 biu2 gaak3 tin4 soeng6 soeng1 hou6 ming4 cing1
